svg.title: West region profitability dashboard: $739,814 sales, $110,799 profit, 15.0% profit ratio, the highest of the four regions.
svg.desc: Executive profitability overview for the West region, orders from 1/3/2023 to 12/30/2026. Sales are $739,814 and profit $110,799, a 15.0% profit ratio with a 10.89% average discount on 12,466 items. West leads all regions, although Colorado, Oregon and Arizona have a negative profit ratio.
